paite: Himahleh Solomon in Pharaoh tanu ban ah namdang numei tampi a-it hi. Amau Moabte, Ammonte, Edomte, Zidonte leh Hitte ahi uh.
heading: Pathian A Pan Solomon Akiheimang
english: Now King Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh: women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites,

paite: Huai namte tungtang thu TOUPA'N Israel suante kiang ah, "Amau toh na kitentuah het louh ding uh ahi. Na kitentuah uleh apathiante uh lam a na lungtang uh hon ngasak ngeingei ding uh ahi," chi a na hilh khit tak namte ahi uh. Hinapi in Solomon in amau it in alen tinten hi.
english: of the nations concerning which Yahweh said to the children of Israel, “You shall not go among them, neither shall they come among you, for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods.” Solomon joined to these in love.

paite: Huchi in zipi zasagih, kumpipa tanute anei a, mei zathum anei hi. Huai azite'n alungtang apikawisak uhi.
english: He had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines. His wives turned his heart away.

paite: Hichi ahong hi a, Solomon ahong upat nung in, azite'n pathian dangte lam ah alungtang apikawisak uhi. Huchi in apa David lungtang bang in TOUPA a Pathian lam ah alungtang ahoihkimta kei hi.
heading: Solomon Melmate
english: When Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not perfect with Yahweh his God, as the heart of David his father was.

paite: Solomon in Zidonte pathiannu Ashtaroth leh Ammonte pathian kihhuai mahmah Milkom azuita hi.
english: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

paite: Huchi in Solomon in TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahihta a, apa David bang in TOUPA azui tettet kei hi.
english: Solomon did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and didn’t go fully after Yahweh, as David his father did.

paite: Huchi in Solomon in Jerusalem chin a mual ah Moabte pathian kihhuai mahmah Khemosh a ding leh Ammon suante Pathian kihhuai mahmah Molek a ding in mun sang abawlta hi.
english: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, on the mountain that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech the abomination of the children of Ammon.

paite: Huai mah bang in namdang azi tengteng apathiante uh kiang a kithoih a gimlim hal zelte a ding leng abawlsak hi.
english: So he did for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA Israelte' Pathian, akiang a nihvei kilak khinsa alungtang in alehngatsan ziak in, Solomon tung ah TOUPA ahehta hi.
english: Yahweh was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from Yahweh, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,

paite: Hiai thu, pathian dangte na zui ding ahi kei, chih thu a na pepa TOUPA thupiak lah azui kei hi.
english: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods; but he didn’t keep that which Yahweh commanded.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Solomon kiang ah, "Hichibang in na omta a, ka thukhun leh ka dan thusehte zuih dia thu ka hon piak lah na zuita kei hi. Gam ka hon sut ngeingei dia, na sikha ka pe ding.
english: Therefore Yahweh said to Solomon, “Because this is done by you, and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely tear the kingdom from you, and will give it to your servant.

paite: Himahleh na pa David ziak in na damsung tel in zaw ka hih tadih kei ding. Himahleh na tapa khut a pan gam pen ka hon sut ding hi.
english: Nevertheless, I will not do it in your days, for David your father’s sake; but I will tear it out of your son’s hand.

paite: Gam tengteng ka hon sut vek kei dia; himahleh ka sikha David ziak leh ka tel Jerusalem ziak in nam khat na tapa ka pe ding," achi hi.
english: However, I will not tear away all the kingdom; but I will give one tribe to your son, for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.”

paite: TOUPA'N Solomon melma ding in Edom mi, Hadad adingkhesakta a; amah Edom gam kumpipa suan ahi.
heading: Solomon Melmate
english: Yahweh raised up an adversary to Solomon: Hadad the Edomite. He was one of the king’s offspring in Edom.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Edom gam a David a-om lai a, amithahte uh vui ding a asepaih heutu Joab ahohtouh a, Edom mi pasal peuhmah ava thah khit nung in,
english: For when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the army had gone up to bury the slain, and had struck every male in Edom

paite: Joab leh Israel mi tengteng kha guktak Edom gam a pasal tengteng ahihlup khit masiah om uhi.
english: (for Joab and all Israel remained there six months, until he had cut off every male in Edom),

paite: Hadad leh apa sikhate lak a Edom mi khenkhatte Aigupta gam ah atai ua; Hadad ahihleh naupang neu ahi lai hi.
english: Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt, when Hadad was still a little child.

paite: Midian gam a pan apawt ua, Paran ahong tung uh. Paran a pan mite api ua, Aigupta gam, Aigupta gam kumpipa Pharaoh kiang atungsuk ua; ama'n inn ana pia a, nek dingte ana ngaihtuahsak a, gam leng ana pia hi.
english: They arose out of Midian and came to Paran; and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house, and appointed him food, and gave him land.

paite: Hadad tung ah Pharaoh mit atung mahmah a, huchi in ama zi sanggamnu, kumpinu Tahpenes sanggamnu azi ding in apia hi.
english: Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

paite: Tahpenes sanggamnu in tapa Genubath aneihsak a, Tahpenes in Pharaoh inn ah anawinek tawpna abawlsak hi. Pharaoh inn ah Pharaoh tapate lak ah Genubath a-omta hi.
english: The sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.

paite: Hadad in Aigupta gam a pan David apute kiang ah a-ihmuta chih leh sepaih heutu Joab leng asita chih ana zak in, Hadad in Pharaoh kiang ah, "Ka gam ua ka paitheihna ding in hon pawtsak ve," achi hi.
english: When Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the army was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, “Let me depart, that I may go to my own country.”

paite: Huchi in Pharaoh in akiang ah, "Ka kiang a nå om in taksap bang na nei a? Ngai in, huchi a na gam ua pai nawn na tup maimah?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Bangmah nei lou e. Bang teng hileh hon paisak himhim in," achi hi.
english: Then Pharaoh said to him, “But what have you lacked with me, that behold, you seek to go to your own country?” He answered, “Nothing, however only let me depart.”

paite: Pathian in amelma ding in Eliadah tapa Rezon, atoupa Hadadezer, Zobah kumpipa a pan taimangsa leng adingsak nawn hi.
english: God raised up an adversary to him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord, Hadadezer king of Zobah.

paite: David in Zobah a mite athah lai in ama'n akiang ah mite akaikhawm a, sepaih heutu in ana pang hi. Damaskas ah ahoh ua, huai ah ateng ua, Damaskas ah kumpipa in atuta hi.
english: He gathered men to himself, and became captain over a troop, when David killed them of Zobah. They went to Damascus and lived there, and reigned in Damascus.

paite: Hadad in buaina tut behlap in Solomon damsung teng Israelte melma ahi gige a; Israelte aho mahmah a, Siria gam tung ah vai ahawm hi.
english: He was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, in addition to the mischief of Hadad. He abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.

paite: Nebat tapa Jeroboam, Zered a Ephraim mi Solomon sikha mah, anu min Zeruah ahi a, meithai ahi, huai mi'n leng kumpipa tung ah akhut alik sam hi.
heading: Jeroboam Kiang A Pathian Thuchiam
english: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also lifted up his hand against the king.

paite: Kumpipa tung a akhut ahon likna san hichibang ahi: Solomon in Millo abawl a, apa David khua asiatna lailai abawlhoih hi.
english: This was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of his father David’s city.

paite: Jeroboam ahihleh mihat leh hangsan ahi a; huchi in Solomon in huai tangval mithanuamtak ahi chih atheih ziak in Joseph inkote nasep tengteng tung ah heutu in abawl hi.
english: The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw that the young man was industrious, and he put him in charge of all the labor of the house of Joseph.

paite: Huai lai in hichi ahong hi a, Jerusalem a pan Jeroboam apawtkhiak lai in Shiloh mi zawlnei Ahijah in lampi ah ana mu a; Ahijah in puan thak asilh a; amau gel kia in gamlak ah a-om uhi.
english: At that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the way. Now Ahijah had clad himself with a new garment; and the two of them were alone in the field.

paite: Ahijah in apuan thak silh ala a, nen sawm-le-nih in abotkek hi.
english: Ahijah took the new garment that was on him, and tore it in twelve pieces.

paite: Jeroboam kiang ah, "Nen sawm la in," TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi, "Ngai in, Solomon khut a pan lalgam ka sut dia, nam sawm nang ka hon pe ding.
english: He said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and will give ten tribes to you

paite: Himahleh ka sikha David ziak leh Israel nam tengteng lak a ka tel khopi, Jerusalem ziak in nam khat anei ding;
english: (but he shall have one tribe, for my servant David’s sake and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel),

paite: amau hon paisan a, Zidonte pathiannu Ashtaroth, Moabte pathian Kemosh leh Ammonte pathian Milkom abiak ziak un leh ka mitmuh a thil hoih hih ding leh ka sehte leh ka vaihawmte zui dia apa David bang a ka lampite azuih louh ziak in.
english: because they have forsaken me, and have worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon. They have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in my eyes, and to keep my statutes and my ordinances, as David his father did.

paite: "Gam pumpi in ahihleh ka sut kei dia; himahleh ka thupiakte leh ka dan thusehte zuipa, ka tel, ka sikha David ziak in adamsung in kumpipa in ka omsak lai ding.
english: “‘However, I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand, but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake whom I chose, who kept my commandments and my statutes,

paite: Himahleh atapa khut a pan in lalgam ka sutkhe dia, nang ka hon pe ding, nam sawmte tan in leng.
english: but I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand and will give it to you, even ten tribes.

paite: Ka sikha David in ka min omna ding a ka tel khopi Jerusalem a ka ma a vak aneih gige theihna ding in nam khat bel atapa ka pe ding hi.
english: I will give one tribe to his son, that David my servant may have a lamp always before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen for myself to put my name there.

paite: Nang ka hon sep ding a, na ut tengteng bang in vai na hawm dia, Israelte kumpipa na hi ding.
english: I will take you, and you shall reign according to all that your soul desires, and shall be king over Israel.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, thu ka hon piak peuhmah na pom a, ka lampite na zuih a, ka sikha David bang a ka dan thusehte leh ka thupiakte zui dia ka mitmuh a thil hoih na hihleh na kiang ah ka om dia, David a dia ka dinkipsak bang in inkuan kip ka hon dinkhiaksak dia, Israelte ka hon pe ding hi.
english: It shall be, if you will listen to all that I command you, and will walk in my ways, and do that which is right in my eyes, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did, that I will be with you, and will build you a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel to you.

paite: Huchi in David suan ka hihgim dia, himahleh tangtawn in zaw ahi kei ding," achi hi.
english: I will afflict the offspring of David for this, but not forever.’”

paite: Huaiziak in Solomon in Jeroboam thah atum a, Jeroboam a ding a, Aigupta gam ah, Aigupta gam kumpipa Shishak kiang ah atai a, Solomon sih matan Aigupta gam ah a-omta hi.
english: Therefore Solomon sought to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam arose and fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

paite: Solomon tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng leh apilna Solomon thilhih gelhna bu ah atuang kei a hia?
heading: Solomon Sihna / (2 Kro 9.29-31)
english: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, aren’t they written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

paite: Solomon in Israel tengteng tung a Jerusalem a vai ahawm sung kum sawmli ahi.
english: The time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

paite: Huchi in Solomon apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, apa David khopi ah avui uh. Huchi in atapa Rehoboam asik in ahong lalta hi.
english: Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
